name: High Mega Blaster
main_effect: [Main] Choose 1 of your Digimon with [Insect] in any of its traits. Suspend 2 of your opponent's Digimon with DP less than or equal to the DP of the chosen Digimon. Then, 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon can't unsuspend during your opponent's next unsuspend phase.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Suspend 2 of your opponent's Digimon.
